name: gdg-rbu-eventhub
description: GDG RBU EventHub - Event Management & Registration System

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

scripts.build:render: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
